src/agent_runtime/gateways/init.py

Python · Tier A

Durable gateway registry for Agent UI routing.

src/agent_runtime/gateways/execution_scope.py

Python · Tier A

Resolve ordered Gateway IDs into isolated primary and sibling execution contexts.

Responsibilities

  • Derive transport, platform, capabilities and default roots from the existing registry.

Boundaries

  • No alternate registry, scheduler, connection probe or operation authorization.

Lifecycle

  • Admission and recovery validate selected records before handing contexts to Activities.

State

  • Produces fresh dictionaries only; the caller owns run checkpoint persistence.

Security

  • Browser transport fields are ignored. Missing/disabled targets fail closed; offline records retain addressability until ordinary dispatch admission.

Collaborators

  • selection.py validates intent; store.py supplies records; gateway.py adapts HTTP errors.

Public surface

  • resolve_selection returns primary fields, stable selection and a multi-target map.

@see src/agent_runtime/api/agent_ui_support/gateway.py

@see src/agent_runtime/native/gateway_scope.py

Significant symbols

resolve_selection 93 Resolve every selected ID, preserving order and the explicit primary. Offline records remain addressable; missing and disabled records fail closed. A one-target scope keeps the legacy tool schema by omitting the target map.

src/agent_runtime/gateways/memory_store.py

Python · Tier A

Keep Controller Gateway registrations, peer trust and update records in one RAM authority domain. MemoryGatewayStore uses RecordRepository transactions for unique nicknames, guarded edits, trust enrollment and stale-probe fencing, while GatewayRecords maintains derived selection/order indexes. Shared health methods perform network I/O outside transactions; results publish only for the original target. Recovery tables and checkpointing retain state on disk without becoming a second live SQL authority.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation

schemas 74 Describe the RAM domain's keys, JSON columns and node/enabled/update indexes from the initialized recovery schema. Registry and update admission can then observe and change related records within one hub transaction.
GatewayRecords 110 Maintain derived selection revision, registration order and nickname indexes alongside authoritative Gateway rows in the same transaction.
GatewayRecords.changed 114 Advance admission revision when selection-relevant fields change, assign missing insertion order and update the ASCII-folded nickname index. Ordinary health timestamps alone do not invalidate admission snapshots.
MemoryGatewayStore 158 Own live Controller registry configuration and verified observations in RAM. Reuse the standalone store's normalizers and transport logic while supplying atomic mutations, snapshot reads and stale-probe fencing; checkpointing owns disk persistence.
MemoryGatewayStore.get 234 Return a detached validated record for one trimmed ID from an immutable view, or None without contacting the host.
MemoryGatewayStore.list 241 Read enabled or all registrations from one view and sort by enabled state, ASCII-folded nickname and ID. Returned records cannot mutate the published RAM roots.
MemoryGatewayStore.find_by_node 267 Resolve an enabled node, preferring configuration-origin registrations and stable insertion order. Empty or missing names return None without a discovery probe.
MemoryGatewayStore.create 280 Build a new inbound record outside the transaction, then atomically check nickname uniqueness and publish it. Return a detached copy; health probing remains a management-service responsibility.
MemoryGatewayStore.update 293 Re-read the record and run an optional dependency guard inside the same mutation transaction. Normalize edits, enforce nickname uniqueness and invalidate capabilities on retargeting; return None if the target disappeared.
MemoryGatewayStore.seed_from_config 314 Insert only absent stable configuration IDs, one transaction per endpoint. Preserve existing edits and choose collision-free labels. No implicit network endpoint is added.
MemoryGatewayStore.pin_outbound_identity 358 Atomically bind an already verified outbound proof to an enabled node when its current trust permits it. A blocked or different saved key rejects the connection without replacing identity.
MemoryGatewayStore.upsert_outbound 389 Revalidate a supplied peer pin within the publication transaction and update or create the node's outbound registration. Prefer outbound origin then stable insertion order; preserve omitted support tags but replace default-directory evidence from the new hello only.
MemoryGatewayStore.mark_outbound_disconnected 490 Publish offline status and a bounded disconnect error only for an existing outbound row. Session replacement ownership is checked by the route before invoking this method.

Persist identity_changed atomically before raising on a mismatched key; successful capture records HTTPS, pin and certificate observations without replacing prior first-seen context.

MemoryGatewayStore._restart_observed 682 Acknowledge a process change only after its reset intent has been saved.
MemoryGatewayStore.delete 723 Recheck the optional management guard and delete the registration within one transaction. Missing IDs return False; execution history and the remote process remain owned elsewhere.
repository 743 Reuse the hub's one Gateway repository or create it at the first requested recovery path. Reject subsequent requests with a different canonical path rather than silently splitting registry authority.

src/agent_runtime/gateways/releases.py

Python · Tier A

Discover bounded, cached GitHub release metadata for Gateway and Server updates. ReleaseCatalog filters uploaded stable releases, verifies descriptor/package identity, retains the previous catalog on errors and orders compatible offers by publication identity. repository_name validates discovery settings; package_descriptor reads a sidecar and pins an owner-selected URL without downloading package bytes. Independent update coordinators own acceptance and installers own replacement. Injected clocks/openers support offline tests; ETag caching and rate-limit backoff constrain repeated network reads.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
repository_name 43 Normalize an owner/repository or HTTPS GitHub repository URL to the persisted catalog setting. An empty string disables discovery; unsupported URL forms and malformed names raise ValueError before fetching metadata.
package_descriptor 61 Read at most 2 MiB of companion metadata with a 15-second timeout, using the Gateway or supplied Server descriptor contract. Derive the default sidecar URL without the package query string, validate HTTPS redirects and suppress network details that could expose signed URLs. Bind the selected mirror/package URL into the validated descriptor without downloading package bytes.
GitHubRedirects 139 Constrain release-catalog redirects to HTTPS on the recognized GitHub API/download hosts. Custom package/sidecar URLs use the separate shared PackageRedirects policy.
GitHubRedirects.redirect_request 142 Reject downgraded, credential-bearing or unrelated-host release redirects before delegating to urllib's normal redirect construction.
ReleaseCatalog 164 Cache bounded release metadata and offer compatible builds only when the installed build is present in the selected catalog. The same owner supports Gateway and Server contracts; explicit package download, acceptance and installation occur elsewhere.
ReleaseCatalog.configure 194 Validate the repository setting and clear releases, cached responses and discovery timing only when it changes. Empty configuration disables checks; accepted operation descriptors are outside this mutable catalog.
ReleaseCatalog.fetch 212 Fetch bounded JSON with conditional ETag requests and reuse a cached body on HTTP 304. Record Retry-After/rate-reset delays for 403/429, then propagate the error so check can preserve the previous trusted release set and expose failure status.
ReleaseCatalog.check 255 Use a nonblocking owner lock and normal 15-minute interval, with force unable to bypass recorded rate limits. Enumerate at most 100 release pages, ignore draft/prerelease/unpublished rows and validate each uploaded descriptor against its target, release, package size and optional digest. Reuse immutable marker cache entries and retain the old catalog on incomplete/invalid enumeration; metadata errors update diagnostic state rather than downloading a package.
ReleaseCatalog.summary 494 Return small polling observations without copying the full release audit.
ReleaseCatalog.evidence 531 Page a completed immutable report; signal replacement instead of mixing generations.
ReleaseCatalog.platform_releases 554 Read only validated packages for the selected installation's exact platform.
ReleaseCatalog.order 566 Not yet documented
ReleaseCatalog.identity 569 Resolve unambiguous published membership; package IDs cannot compare components.
ReleaseCatalog.comparison 580 Describe the newest publication independently of installation offers/readiness.
ReleaseCatalog.offer 659 Find the installed build in the exact target/Server-variant catalog, then choose the newest compatible later publication. Return a reason for disabled discovery, unknown installed identity or newer builds requiring manual migration; version strings alone do not establish ordering.

src/agent_runtime/gateways/selection.py

Python · Tier A

Validate ID-only Gateway selection and remove resolved authority from durable intent.

Responsibilities

  • Bound and validate versioned selection, ordered IDs and primary compatibility.

Boundaries

  • Registry resolution, live availability and operation permissions are separate owners.

Lifecycle

  • API validation accepts intent; task/event capture copies it before persistence.

State

  • Pure model and dictionary transforms; existing domain stores persist the result.

Security

  • Public selection forbids transport and capability fields. Runtime stripping removes supplied connection data and trust markers without granting execution permission.

Collaborators

  • execution_scope.py resolves records; tasks/models.py and events/scope.py persist intent.

Public surface

  • GatewaySelection validates input; selection_from_context checks legacy agreement; gateway_intent_context removes resolved metadata; strip_gateway_runtime sanitizes ingress.

@see docs/gateway-execution-scope.md

src/agent_runtime/gateways/store.py

Python · Tier A

Define Gateway registry records, endpoint/nickname normalization and shared transport/health behavior. AgentGatewayStore selects the hub-owned RAM repository for the running Controller; without an owner it provides the standalone version-5 SQLite store used by isolated consumers and fixtures. Network observations and configured identity remain distinct from execution authority. Management services own dependency guards; record construction does not contact a host, and health failures preserve the saved registration.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
_health_error_message 136 Translate a probe exception into safe reachability, authentication or trust wording. Disabled and already-blocked records explicitly report that reachability was not checked; a saved failure is not a fresh connection observation.
AgentGatewayRecord 192 Carry endpoint configuration, origin, observed capabilities/health and TLS enrollment identity between registry and consumers. These fields describe the selected host; cached status alone neither authenticates a socket nor authorizes execution.
AgentGatewayStore 234 Select the active hub's RAM repository for owned paths; otherwise expose the standalone SQLite implementation. Shared normalization and transport/health methods are reused by MemoryGatewayStore, whose publication hooks add transaction fencing.
AgentGatewayStore.seed_from_config 365 Insert missing configured node endpoints using stable IDs, preserving existing user edits and disabled state. Prefer an explicit endpoint map, supplement its default node from gateway_url. Unconfigured installations use their built-in LocalMachine.
AgentGatewayStore.list 428 Return validated registrations ordered by enabled state, case-insensitive nickname and ID. Filtering disabled records affects this read only and never probes hosts.
AgentGatewayStore.get 440 Load one trimmed registry ID or return None. The record includes retained observations and private transport metadata for internal consumers.
AgentGatewayStore.get_default 451 Choose among enabled registrations by connected status, then configuration origin, nickname and ID. This is a presentation/default-selection fallback, not a health probe or permission to substitute a captured run target.
AgentGatewayStore.find_by_node 479 Resolve an enabled exact node name, preferring configuration-origin records. Empty or unmatched names return None; unlike the RAM implementation, SQL does not add an explicit insertion-order tie-breaker.
AgentGatewayStore.pin_outbound_identity 506 Under an immediate transaction, bind a verified proof to an enabled configured node only if its existing pin permits it. Reject blocked or different identities without replacing trust; the caller verifies the handshake before this write.
AgentGatewayStore.upsert_outbound 534 Record one outbound hello, preferring an existing outbound-origin node. A supplied verified identity must match an enabled pinned record; internal callers omitting it can create a synthetic registration. Omitted capability tags preserve prior support, while default_cwd is replaced solely from this handshake.
AgentGatewayStore.mark_outbound_disconnected 662 Mark an existing outbound registration offline with timestamps and a bounded error; preserve its endpoint and capability history. Missing IDs return None and inbound records remain unchanged.
AgentGatewayStore.create 686 Validate a user-created inbound profile and unique nickname, then insert it without network I/O. The management service owns the subsequent health check and reports offline status separately from registration success.
AgentGatewayStore.update 747 Apply the shared editable-field normalizer and nickname uniqueness check. Retargeting scheme/host/port/node clears capability observations; dependency management guards belong to the caller in standalone SQL mode.
AgentGatewayStore.record_tls_peer 790 Compare or establish the peer public-key pin inside an immediate transaction after rechecking endpoint, enabled state and enrollment. Commit identity_changed before raising on mismatch; successful trust upgrades HTTP to HTTPS while retaining the first context URL and first-seen time.
AgentGatewayStore.mark_identity_changed 850 Persist a blocked identity and offline observation without overwriting its saved pin. Recovery requires an explicit management decision, not automatic enrollment of the replacement key.
AgentGatewayStore.forget_tls_identity 861 Clear trust and capabilities while retaining the profile and incrementing enrollment so old credential scopes cannot be reused. Standalone SQL relies on its management caller for operation guards; the RAM override also checks update holds atomically.
AgentGatewayStore.prepare_transport 883 Validate a configured inbound target and capture or verify its TLS identity before operational traffic. Existing explicit unpinned loopback HTTP can remain local development traffic unless upgrade is requested; only positively identified legacy HTTP may retain the insecure-legacy state after TLS failure.
AgentGatewayStore.execution_opener 935 Build the shared authenticated opener with this repository and selected record, so operational sockets enforce current endpoint identity and controller proof.
AgentGatewayStore.delete 942 Remove one standalone registry row and report whether it existed. This does not stop a remote Gateway, delete execution history or perform the management service's dependency checks.
AgentGatewayStore.health_check 1056 Observe outbound session presence locally or probe inbound transport/capabilities outside repository transactions. Preserve support when tags are omitted, refresh the observed directory, and record bounded failure text without deleting the profile. RAM publication rejects results for a target edited during the probe. Feature admission can explicitly require current evidence instead of retaining tags omitted by the response.
initialize_gateway_schema 1206 Enforce the supported version-5 registry layout, then create endpoint, trust and capability columns and lookup indexes. Recovery import and standalone storage share this initializer; it is not a runtime migration to a second authority.
new_gateway_record 1261 Construct an unprobed inbound profile with a new ID and timestamps. Normalize host/scheme, accept a URL host's port, clamp the port, validate the nickname and reject an empty host; persistence and uniqueness checks occur later.
updated_gateway_record 1302 Copy only editable profile fields, normalize them and validate the resulting record. Preserve the exact configured URL prefix for label/cwd/enabled/node-only edits; rebuild the URL only when scheme, host or port changes. Trust metadata is retained until its explicit reset path.

src/agent_runtime/gateways/tool_scope.py

Python · Tier A

Project captured Gateway scope and validate ordinary-tool routing metadata.

Responsibilities

  • Share selected-ID enumeration, safe labels and target extraction with the catalog and Gateway skill. Business adapters receive only their original arguments.

Boundaries

  • No registry discovery, network probes, permissions or scheduling.

Lifecycle

  • Model projection and Activity creation consume server-resolved run contexts.

State

  • Pure dictionary projections; no persistent or mutable routing authority.

Security

  • Structured selection fences even surplus runtime map entries. Missing siblings fail closed; labels cannot expose transport addresses or credential assignments.

Collaborators

  • native/activities.py owns target isolation and execution; selection.py owns IDs.

Public surface

  • selected_targets, target_property and split_target serve runtime routing; safe_label supplies bounded presentation text.

@see src/agent_runtime/skills/gateway/tools.py

src/agent_runtime/gateways/update_admission.py

Python · Tier A

Apply Server and per-Gateway update fences inside the existing task/native RAM transaction. targets retains every accepted primary/sibling Gateway; holds fences execution and continuation descendants immediately for accepted updates. task_held supports scheduler projection, while guard_task and guard_run reject new execution before publication. These helpers perform no remote request, package download or disk write and never retarget a task to bypass maintenance.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
targets 15 Collect the primary, direct context and captured multi-Gateway selection IDs, excluding empty identities. Update admission considers every accepted target rather than silently dropping a held sibling Gateway.
holds 24 Check the global Server fence first, then each targeted Gateway operation in the caller's RAM transaction. Every accepted update and rollback_failed holds execution until resolution.
task_held 45 Project whether a task's accepted primary/sibling Gateway scope is held by an update. Missing tasks return False; the same transactional predicate is used by selection and guarded mutation.
guard_task 54 Reject held task admission with a stable Server or Gateway conflict code, preserving the accepted target set. This helper does not wait, contact a target or substitute an available Gateway.
guard_run 74 Walk continuation ancestors and combine native authority with captured Gateway scope before checking transactional update holds. Reject held execution before publication; a visited set prevents ancestry loops from causing unbounded traversal.

src/agent_runtime/gateways/updates.py

Python · Tier A

Coordinate Gateway software updates from the Controller without downloading or installing packages there. GatewayUpdates pins release/preview identity, captures admitted tasks and runs atomically, cancels affected work and dispatches only checkpointed intent over authenticated direct/outbound management. It persists progress and uncertain connectivity separately, verifies build/boot/readiness before confirmation, and preserves rollback failures for recovery. Release discovery and capability observation have independent freshness; the remote Gateway/helper owns local drain, package verification and replacement.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation

Package preparation/replacement belongs to the Gateway's independent installer; this owner dispatches only checkpointed intent and releases work only after verified readiness or a resolved terminal outcome.

GatewayUpdates.stop 99 Signal both workers, wake the progress loop, and join with bounded waits. Accepted update operations remain in controller persistence for later recovery.

GatewayUpdates.check_gateway 160 Refresh releases and this target only; partial check failures remain observable.
GatewayUpdates.source 225 Expose the configured Gateway release repository independently of Server update discovery.

Outbound transport requires a live session with matching Gateway ID and verified peer identity; direct transport uses GatewayClient authentication and a 1 MiB JSON response bound. Both paths use a ten-second timeout and perform no package download.

This check uses local observations and never treats a cached unsupported result as freshly verified.

Failed probes mark cached observations stale; per-operation errors retain uncertainty without stopping other updates. rollback_failed stays fenced for explicit recovery and is not automatically retried by this loop.
